set.acceptance: A testscript where a question blocks an accepted change set: rhiza question answer <q> <words> --change <cs> --json makes ready drop the reason and fold-ok passes; --dry-run writes nothing; answering an unknown question exits 2; two answers to two questions get distinct handles; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
set.statement: A question.answer operation answers an open question that blocks a change set by recording the owner's words as a Decision quoting them, linked answers to the question, under a free handle, in the change set it blocks
